shortDescription: A third-person, 2.5D wave-based roguelike set in an ancient Mesoamerican-inspired world. Choose your Anchor, unlock powerful abilities, and survive increasingly dangerous waves of enemies.
longDescription:
Anchor Bound is a wave-based roguelike set in a mysterious ancient Mesoamerican-inspired world, drawing inspiration from the cultures, mythology, architecture, temples, warriors, and landscapes of the Maya eras.

Enter a dangerous world filled with ancient ruins, massive stone temples, forgotten civilizations, dense jungles, sacred grounds, and powerful enemies. Fight your way through wave after wave of increasingly dangerous foes using your weapons, normal attacks, and powerful combat abilities.

At the heart of the game are three mysterious Anchor types. During your journey, you can bind yourself to an Anchor and gain access to powerful abilities that change the way you fight. Each Anchor offers its own unique powers, combat possibilities, and strategies, allowing you to experiment with different playstyles as you survive longer and face stronger enemies.

Fight normally with your weapons, combine attacks with Anchor powers, or build your entire combat strategy around the abilities granted by your chosen Anchor. Every wave provides another opportunity to become stronger, experiment with abilities, and prepare for what comes next.

As the waves progress, enemies become stronger, more numerous, and more dangerous. You will need to manage your abilities, position yourself carefully, learn enemy attack patterns, and make strategic decisions about how you use your Anchor powers.

Anchor Bound is built around fast, repeatable survival runs where every attempt gives you another opportunity to improve your strategy and push further into the battlefield. Enter the ancient world, survive as many waves as possible, discover the power of the Anchors, and see how far you can push your warrior before the enemies overwhelm you.

Choose your Anchor. Enter the battlefield. Survive the waves. Become powerful enough to face what waits beyond them.
platforms: PC (Windows, Linux, macOS), PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, Xbox One, Xbox One S, Xbox One X, Xbox Series S, Xbox Series X, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Steam Deck.
story: Explore a mysterious ancient Mesoamerican-inspired world filled with forgotten civilizations, ancient ruins, massive temples, and dangerous enemies. Discover the powers of three mysterious Anchors while fighting to survive increasingly difficult waves.
worldDescription: A mysterious ancient Mesoamerican-inspired world featuring massive stone temples, forgotten civilizations, ancient ruins, dense jungles, sacred grounds, and dangerous battlefields inspired by Maya-era cultures and landscapes.
characters: The player controls a warrior who must survive increasingly dangerous enemies using weapons, combat abilities, and the powers of three mysterious Anchors.
gameplay: Fight increasingly difficult waves of enemies using normal weapon attacks, combat mechanics, and powerful Anchor abilities. Experiment with different combat strategies, manage your abilities, and survive as many waves as possible.
mechanics: Wave-based combat, weapon attacks, Anchor binding, special abilities, player movement, tether mechanics, dash mechanics, enemy AI, enemy progression, camera movement, arena camera transitions, combat positioning, ability management, and survival gameplay.
multiplayer: Single-player experience. No multiplayer functionality specified.
features: Three mysterious Anchor types, unique Anchor abilities, wave-based combat, increasingly difficult enemies, ancient Mesoamerican-inspired environments, repeatable survival runs, third-person gameplay, arena-based combat, and multiple combat strategies.
